mode 0 badge|LYRICS · LOCAL AUDIO
mode 0 workflow|Creates timed lyrics with local Whisper and MMS. Without an authored lyric source, keeps the locally transcribed words for review.
mode 0 boundary|Audio stays local. Codex receives bounded transcript text only if wording review is needed.
mode 0 empty|The lyric pipeline produced no accepted timed cues. Existing lyrics were left unchanged.
mode 1 badge|SCENES · LOCAL AUDIO
mode 1 workflow|Creates scene changes: measured local audio feeds the deterministic scene planner.
mode 1 boundary|Runs locally. Audio and analysis output do not leave this computer.
mode 1 empty|Measured analysis produced no validated scene changes. Existing cues were left unchanged.
mode 2 badge|FEELINGS · SENDS AUDIO
mode 2 workflow|Creates feeling cues: the full track is sent to OpenRouter MiMo, then the local planner stages cues.
mode 2 boundary|Track audio is sent to OpenRouter for MiMo; Zero Data Retention is requested.
mode 2 empty|MiMo produced no validated feeling cues. Existing semantic events were left unchanged.
mode 3 badge|ALL 3 · SENDS AUDIO
mode 3 workflow|Creates timed lyrics, scene changes, and feeling cues by running all implemented lanes.
mode 3 boundary|Track audio goes to OpenRouter MiMo with ZDR requested; Codex gets bounded transcript text only if wording review is needed.
mode 3 empty|The completed workflow produced no validated editor changes. Existing content was left unchanged.
